records.subject: spec-guard-0.58.1-codex-handoff-session
evidence: command:<installed>/hooks/setup-convention.sh local --host=codex in a temporary git project, then codex exec -s workspace-write with a prompt asking the agent to write the Spec of the one mapped module and hand it over for review, no Plan and no code

result:exit 0; the answer (about 1480 characters) carried the goal and scope with what is out of scope, the proposed contract, assumptions and trade-offs, acceptance, open questions, what the approval authorizes, how to approve, and that the project can switch to combined review; it was not a one-line summary with a link
result:one run of one small module, so this shows the rule reaches a Codex agent and can be followed, not that every handoff will follow it
result:codex exec wrote a trust entry for the temporary project into ~/.codex/config.toml; it was the only difference and was removed, and the file equals its state before the run
